column2: Yes

Your color's been good lately, and your appetite's back in full force!
You're completely better now!
I always knew you might say it someday... but...
I see...
No one has the right to hold you back...
You're $$自由$$ to go outside...
But my feelings matter too...!
I'm sorry. Do you really want to go out?
Go outside!
Stay inside!
I suppose you're right. It may help you recover your $$記憶$$ sooner...
Besides...
You're not some $$カゴの鳥$$ of mine...
But if you go outside, remember this one thing!
You'll meet all kinds of people in town, but many people with black $$羽$$ are violent,
so please be very careful...
And think of this $$ネックレス$$ as a $$お守り$$. Make sure you wear it at all times!
Do you still... want to go outside?
I see. It's still too soon, isn't it?
Oh, thank goodness.
I had this feeling that you and I might be separated,
and it had me worried.
But... if you ever want to go outside...
Promise you won't make me worry again!
